title: FxRate
description: The unified USD→₽ rate behind every ₽ price (§11.4). Official Bank of Russia daily fixing, cached; served at GET /prices/fx. `source`: cbr = today's fix · cache = last cached · fallback = emergency constant.

asOf.description: CBR fixing datetime (or when cached / fell back)

stale.description: true if not freshly fetched from CBR this cycle
